Ebook.title: Patient Flow
Ebook.subtitle: How to turn your patients into loyal clients
Ebook.byAuthors: By Dr. Osama Saleh & Dr. Ahmed Maher
description: Most dental marketing campaigns fail — not because ads don't work, but because the clinic behind them isn't ready to receive the patients they bring in. Advertising is the last step, not the first.

Patient Flow is a practical, no-fluff guide to the internal system your clinic needs before you spend a single pound on ads: how to welcome a patient, how to talk to them, how to handle price objections with confidence, and how to turn one visit into lifelong loyalty.
toc: Why most dental marketing campaigns fail
The golden loyalty equation: known, liked, trusted
The psychology of buying — the battle between mind and heart
The 5-step rule for handling difficult moments
Scripted answers for "Your prices are too high"
Reception and environment that build trust
Psychological pricing and the illusion of choice
Educating your patients to earn their trust
